steps.command: cd ~/benchmarks/xsbench.noindex/corpora && f=large-text/$(ls large-text | head -1) && PATH=$PATH:/opt/homebrew/bin && echo "== $(hostname), $(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN) cores, load $(uptime | sed "s/.*average[s]*: //"), $f" && for t in 1 8; do for l in 1 2 3; do printf "zstd level %s, %s thread(s): " $l $t; zstd -b$l -i3 -T$t "$f" 2>&1 | tr "\r" "\n" | grep "MB/s" | tail -1 | sed "s/^.*: *//"; done; done

cd ~/benchmarks/xsyncv4/lab/corpora && f=large-text/$(ls large-text | head -1) && PATH=$PATH:/opt/homebrew/bin && echo "== $(hostname), $(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN) cores, load $(uptime | sed "s/.*average[s]*: //"), $f" && for t in 1 8; do for l in 1 2 3; do printf "zstd level %s, %s thread(s): " $l $t; zstd -b$l -i3 -T$t "$f" 2>&1 | tr "\r" "\n" | grep "MB/s" | tail -1 | sed "s/^.*: *//"; done; done
